description: Held-out perception set. Hand-labelled roles for entities in short statements using vocabulary outside ROLE_LEXICON and SYNONYMS where possible. Written before the phase 5 perception changes; do not edit to fit the code.

problems.text: The mash tun heats the wort. The thermowell reports the wort temperature to the brewmaster. The brewmaster adjusts the steam jacket.
The triage nurse assigns each patient to a ward. The ward bed census limits admissions. The ambulance bay delivers patients to the emergency department.
The intake screen feeds the clarifier. The clarifier converts turbid water into settled water. The turbidimeter monitors the clarifier outlet. The dosing pump raises the coagulant level.
The load shedder limits incoming requests. The message broker stores the pending jobs. The worker pool consumes the jobs. The latency probe measures the response time.
The irrigation sprinkler delivers moisture to the crop rows. The soil moisture probe monitors the topsoil. The agronomist sets the watering schedule. The cistern holds the rainwater.
The proofing cabinet warms the dough. The baker adjusts the humidifier. The hygrometer reads the cabinet humidity. The dough rises in the cabinet.
The gate agent assigns each passenger to a boarding queue. The jet bridge carries passengers to the aircraft. The baggage carousel delivers luggage to the arrivals hall.
The rectifier converts alternating current into direct current. The smoothing choke reduces the ripple. The bleeder discharges the filter bank. The voltmeter reads the bus level.
The trawler harvests the cod stock. The quota board limits the annual catch. The hatchery restocks the cod. The sonar buoy detects the shoal.
The air handler pushes conditioned air through the ductwork. The damper actuator adjusts the vent opening. The occupancy beacon signals the building manager. The chiller removes heat from the loop.
The replenishment planner decides the reorder quantity. The stockroom shelf holds the unsold goods. The checkout lane delivers sales data to the planner. Shoplifting reduces the shelf count.
The base station transmits the radio signal. The antenna array carries the signal to handsets. The congestion monitor detects overload. The spectrum auctioneer limits the channel width.
The blast stove heats the blast air. The tuyere feeds the air into the hearth. The pyrometer measures the hearth temperature. The slag notch drains the molten waste.
The timetabler assigns each class to a classroom. The classroom capacity limits enrolment. The enrolment office reports the headcount to the timetabler. The pupils consume the lessons.
The turbine nacelle converts wind into torque. The pitch servo adjusts the blade angle. The anemometer measures the gust speed. The substation transformer feeds the grid.
The compounding robot produces the doses. The dispensary shelf stores the vials. The pharmacist approves each prescription. The barcode scanner reads the vial label.
The signal box controls the points. The marshalling yard holds the wagons. The axle counter detects each train. The freight locomotive hauls the wagons to the terminal.
The algal bloom consumes the dissolved nitrogen. The aerator raises the oxygen level. The secchi disk measures the water clarity. The runoff ditch carries fertiliser to the pond.
The inking unit transfers ink to the plate cylinder. The press operator adjusts the ink fountain. The densitometer reads the ink density. The paper reel feeds the web press.
The credit committee sets the lending ceiling. The loan book holds the outstanding balances. The default tracker reports the arrears to the committee. Depositors supply the funds.
The sous chef allocates orders to the stations. The ticket rail holds the pending orders. The fryer converts raw potatoes into chips. The heat lamp warms the plated dishes.
The star tracker measures the attitude. The reaction wheel adjusts the spin rate. The flight computer commands the reaction wheel. The propellant bladder stores the hydrazine.
The catalogue clerk assigns each loan to a borrower. The returns chute delivers books to the sorting room. The overdue ledger records the late fines. The readers consume the books.
The stormwater weir limits the overflow. The detention basin holds the surge. The flow logger measures the trunk sewer level. The outfall discharges the effluent to the estuary.
The batch hopper feeds the sand to the melting tank. The regenerator recovers waste heat. The lehr cools the glass sheet. The gob cutter divides the molten glass.
